notes: Total series: 328 across 12 files. Slug assignments: id_payment_systems (ClearingSettlement_SKNBI, 30 series — SKNBI bilateral clearing system, daily+monthly, value/volume by transaction type and destination city/province); id_capital_markets (IDX_MarketCap_bySector, 1 series — market cap as % of GDP, annual, source CEIC Data); id_money_supply (ReserveMoney_MonetaryBase, 24 series — monetary base, currency in circulation, statutory reserve requirements, excess reserves, daily+monthly; 3 IMF/WB annual aggregates included — unit IDR mn vs IDR bn elsewhere, noted mismatch but source-side, not cleaning error); id_imports_exports (ExportsByCommodity, 30 series — first 5 are BPS key Indonesian export commodities in USD mn monthly; series 6-30 are UN Comtrade HS-code-level micro-commodity exports labelled 'Exports: World: ...' in USD [not USD mn] — unit inconsistency flagged); id_balance_of_payments (TradeBalance, 5 series — 3 annual OECD/BPS in IDR bn or USD mn plus 1 IMF long-run annual; frequency_raw shows P1Y for all, but names say 'Monthly Level' — suspicious: raw freq is annual-aggregated OECD series, not true monthly); id_foreign_investment (DomesticInvestment_PMDN_byProvince, 30 series — BKPM domestic investment realization quarterly, by province — province-granular data confirmed, keep all); id_government_revenue (TaxRevenue, 30 series — DJA forecast + revised budget annual series + actual local government tax receipts by province from BPS — province-granular data for last ~10 series); id_workforce_unemployment (LabourForce_Employment, 30 series — unemployment rate, labour force, employment by status/industry, semiannual and annual; frequency_raw 'Half-yearly ending Aug, Feb' maps to P1Y — note these are truly semiannual but slim.json codes them P1Y, flagged); id_consumer_prices (CPI_byComponent, 30 series — BPS CPI 2022=100 base, full basket + 11 COICOP components + core/volatile/administered/energy sub-indices + YoY % + BI inflation targets); id_gdp_gva_by_industries (GDP_byExpenditureIndustry, 30 series — SNA 2008 quarterly real GDP: expenditure-side components and 17 industry-side GVA breakdowns + CEIC derived real YoY and nominal USD series; file mixes expenditure and industry perspectives — file guide specifies id_gdp_gva_by_industries, applied); id_industrial_production_utilization (CapacityUtilization_byIndustry, 30 series — BI business survey quarterly capacity utilization, manufacturing sub-industries + agriculture/fishery + utilities + OECD manufacturing tendency + Ministry of Industry iron/steel utilization); id_consumer_surveys (ConsumerConfidence_Monthly, 58 series — BI monthly Consumer Confidence Index: headline, present situation, expectations, by expenditure quintile, by municipality/province — province-granular data confirmed, keep all; typo 'Consumer Suvey Index' in source names for household expense allocation series, cleaned in descriptions).
